title: District Listed On Register (The Medallion, Vol. 22, No. 3, March 1985)
creator: Texas Historical Commission
archive: The Portal to Texas History (University of North Texas Libraries)
citation: "District Listed On Register," The Medallion, vol. 22, no. 3 (March 1985), p. 5, Texas Historical Commission, The Portal to Texas History.
notes: Short news article in the Texas Historical Commission's own newsletter, announcing the district's National Register listing. States the district's founding just after emancipation on the southern banks of Buffalo Bayou, its growth into the economic, spiritual, and cultural center of Houston's Black community, its early-20th-century boundaries, three institutions within it (Antioch Baptist Church, the original Colored High School, and the historic Black Carnegie Library Building), the construction date range of its buildings (1870-1935), and the post-1940 reduction of the neighborhood by urban renewal and highway construction.
